 Outside Activities
 Notice of Material Change
Date of Change: February 22, 2023
Organization Chair of the Board of Director of the Liberal Party of Canada (Manitoba)
 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as special Assistant, Manitoba, Ministers' Regional Offices, I recused myself on November 30, 2023, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding a request from Southport Aerospace in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of my father, Irvine Ferris, a board member of Southport Aerospace.
 In the exercise of my official duties as Regional Advisor, West and North in the Office of the Minister of Rural Economic Development, I recused myself on May 16, 2022, from a correspondence in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of the city of Portage la Prairie because my father is the Mayor
 On June 30, 2020, in the exercise of my official duties, I recused myself from participating in a communication in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and the private interests of my relative, who is an employee of the Manitoba Keewatinowi Okimakanak Inc.
 Administrative Monetary Penalty
 Violation of subsection 22(5) of the Conflict of Interest Act:
Failure to disclose within 30 days a material change relating to assets.
